sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: - The IOTV Gen 4 is a US issue armor vest intended to sustain significant damage. It is made using ceramic strike faces and soft armor to cover any other areas. According to testing, this armor is at least able to sustain 2 .30-06 M2 AP impacts, or 7.62x63mm AP, without failure.
